title: RC-09 RC-10 Feed/Search Production Green Gate

requiredEvidence.requirement: Canonical OpenAPI exposes feed and search operations with exact paths, auth and response/error contracts.
Feed pagination has deterministic ordering, stable opaque cursor binding and no duplicate content across traversal.
Visibility, moderation and entitlement checks are enforced before feed delivery and cannot be bypassed by cache.
Search index is derived state and serving rechecks authorization/visibility/moderation as required.
Projection replay/reconciliation is idempotent, observable and auditable.
Unit, integration and security E2E evidence passes for feed/search consistency invariants.
